CHATRING_CONVERSATION_STARTERS.TITLE: Conversation Starters
CHATRING_CONVERSATION_STARTERS.DESCRIPTION: Configure up to four initial questions for each Website Inbox. Visitors see two at a time.
CHATRING_CONVERSATION_STARTERS.NATIVE_MESSAGE_NOTE: A visitor click sends the configured prompt through the existing Website Widget message path.
CHATRING_CONVERSATION_STARTERS.STARTERS_DESCRIPTION: Labels are shown to visitors. Prompts are sent as their ordinary customer messages.
CHATRING_CONVERSATION_STARTERS.LABEL: Visitor label
